description: Nimbz's second Giftige-Blume merge focuses on character roleplay, creative prose, and stricter prompt adherence. It combines storymaxxed, Equinox, Mero-Artemis, Musica, Ortenzya, Gemopus, and Sprinkle. This text-only Gemma 4 31B deployment supports a 65,536-token context window and up to 8,192 output tokens.
name: Gemma 4 Giftige-Blume V2 31B
